localChanges: New players now get a sentence or two of help as they reach each new moment of their first game: founding the first city, choosing research, a unit built, fortifying, a city in disorder or short of food, and barbarians arriving (closes #1295).
Each tip shows once a game. Tick "Don't show help again" on any of them to stop them, or turn them back on with "Show help as you play" in Options.
